title: Lamb of God
lyrics_original: Your only Son, no sin to hide,
But you have sent Him from Your side
To walk upon this guilty sod
And to become the Lamb of God
Oh Lamb of God, sweet Lamb of God,
I love the holy Lamb of God.
O wash me in His precious blood.
My Jesus Christ, the Lamb of God.
Your gift of love, they crucified.
They laughed and scorned Him as He died.
The humble King they named a fraud
And sacrificed the Lamb of God.
Oh Lamb of God, sweet Lamb of God,
I love the holy Lamb of God.
O wash me in His precious blood.
My Jesus Christ, the Lamb of God.
I was so lost I should have died
But You have brought me to Your side
To be led by Your staff and rod
And to be called a child of God.
Oh Lamb of God, sweet Lamb of God,
I love the holy Lamb of God.
O wash me in His precious blood.
My Jesus Christ, the Lamb of God.

bible_verses.english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, "Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!"

knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers, but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ;
how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for sending Your beloved Son to be the Lamb of God for me. I am humbled by the great price Jesus paid on the cross to wash away my sin and set me free. Wash me anew in His precious blood and fill my heart with deep love for my Savior. May my life honor the incredible gift of Your grace today and every day. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: This beloved song draws our hearts to the incredible humility and grace of God. Heavenly Father sent His sinless, precious Son to walk among us and bear the weight of our guilt on the cross. When we contemplate the Lamb of God, we are reminded that our redemption came at the highest price—out of breathtaking love. As you sing, let your heart swell with gratitude, resting in the cleansing power of His sacrifice and drawing near to the Savior who loved you to the end.
